operator.name: GpuMitchSourceOp
operator.description: MITCH market data over DAQIRI GPUDirect: frames land in GPU memory, a GIL-free native drain gathers the UDP payloads into a device ring, and the source decodes MITCH on the GPU into device-resident event batches.

changelog.0.1.0: GPUDirect MITCH receive: DAQIRI places packets in GPU memory (dma-buf), CUDA kernels gather the UDP payloads and check MITCH framing, and a pluggable GPU decoder emits device-resident batches; host-side receive accounting and stall diagnostics.
changelog.0.2.0: Holoscan SDK 5.0 port: declarative operator with typed Params and an OnClock contract; decode fused through GpuIngest and GpuMitchDecoder; the native drain is built before daqiri_init; lane masks restored after daqiri_init and drains started under the process mask.

hardware.name: CUDA GPU
hardware.description: GPUDirect RDMA target (dma-buf); the ring, gather and MITCH decode run on it

hardware.name: NVIDIA ConnectX NIC
hardware.description: Received through DAQIRI (Python bindings, DPDK engine) into GPU memory; needs hugepages

hardware.name: daqiri Python module
hardware.description: The daqiri Python module with the DPDK engine (deploy/igx_thor builds it); its absence fails start() explicitly
